answer_summary: Using the PDF periodic-table value 238.03 a.u. and the two printed isotope masses, the unique uranium-235 atomic fraction is 2/301. The exact raw abundance is 200/301 percent = 0.664451827... percent, reported to three significant figures as 0.664 percent.
assumptions: Natural uranium is modeled as containing only uranium-235 and uranium-238, as stipulated by T4-A1.
The isotope masses 235.04 a.u. and 238.05 a.u. from Q4-1 and the natural-uranium atomic mass 238.03 a.u. from the supplied G1-5 periodic table are treated exactly as printed, following TASK.json.
Average atomic mass is the atomic-fraction-weighted mean of isotope masses.
The final display follows TASK.json's three-significant-figure, half-away-from-zero reporting policy; no tie occurs.
